accessibility.accessibleNameSource: label on sb-command names the search field and the listbox. A group is named by its label. An option is named by its text; the shortcut hint is not part of the name.
announcements: after the search text changes and typing pauses, a polite status announces resultsLabel with the count of visible enabled items, or the sb-command-empty text when nothing matches

moving the active item is announced by the screen reader through aria-activedescendant (option name, position in set); the arrows skip disabled items, so a disabled option is never active and is not announced as unavailable that way; it is found in browse mode
aria: search field: native input with role=combobox, aria-expanded=true (the list is always shown), aria-autocomplete=list, aria-label from label; autocomplete, autocorrect and spellcheck off
search field to list: aria-controls through the ariaControlsElements property; an element reference from a shadow root to the light DOM above it resolves, an ID would not (SB-0009)
active item: aria-activedescendant through the ariaActiveDescendantElement property on the search field, pointing at the active sb-command-item host; cleared when no item matches
list: role=listbox as a host attribute with aria-label copied from label
group: role=group as a host attribute with aria-label from its label; the visible heading is aria-hidden so it is not read twice
item: role=option as a host attribute, aria-selected=true only on the active item, aria-disabled=true when disabled
separator and empty state are role=none inside the listbox (a listbox owns only options and groups); the empty text is announced through the status region
shortcut hint: aria-hidden; when the app really registers the shortcut, the consumer sets aria-keyshortcuts on the item
decorative icons in the search field and items are aria-hidden
filtered-out items, empty groups and separators while searching are hidden from the accessibility tree, not only visually
references (aria-controls, aria-activedescendant) are re-resolved when items are added, removed or filtered
forced colors: the active item is Highlight on HighlightText
accessibility.focusRingVisible: DOM focus stays in the search field, which shows its caret; the active item shows the accent fill plus a 2px inset ring in command.item.active.ring-color. No ring around the search field (Q4), except with no active item (a search with no match): then the search row shows the same ring (command.item.active.ring-color, command.item.active.ring-width; owner decision, 2026-11-12).

formAssociation.note: The search field filters the list; its text is not a value to submit, so Command is not a form control (rule form-associated-controls covers controls that stand in for a native form field). PROPOSAL; owner to confirm (Q3).

keyboard.ArrowDown: next enabled visible item becomes active; stops at the last unless loop
keyboard.ArrowUp: previous enabled visible item becomes active; stops at the first unless loop
keyboard.End: moves the caret to the end of the search text
keyboard.Enter: selects the active item (fires sb-select); never submits a surrounding form
keyboard.Escape: not handled, so it reaches the container (a dialog closes)
keyboard.Home: moves the caret to the start of the search text (APG editable combobox), not to the first item
keyboard.Printable characters: edit the search text; the first matching enabled item becomes active
keyboard.Tab: leaves the command; the search field is its only tab stop

accessibility.missingNameWarning: Console warning, once per sb-command, when label is empty.
accessibility.role: combobox (the search field) controlling a listbox of options, with group for each titled group
accessibility.targetSize: Each item is at least 32px high (20px line plus 6px padding on each side) and spans the list width (WCAG 2.5.8).

antiPatterns.alternative: One action per item, chosen with sb-select
antiPatterns.pattern: Buttons, links or other controls inside an item
antiPatterns.why: An option in a listbox cannot hold interactive content (WAI-ARIA APG Listbox); focus stays in the search field, so the inner control is unreachable by keyboard

useCases.use: sb-command inside sb-dialog (the command palette composition), with groups per section
useCases.when: Site or app search over a known set of pages or actions, opened with a shortcut

useCases.use: sb-command inline, sized by its container
useCases.when: A filterable list of actions shown in the page

useCases.use: filter=manual and render the matching items on input
useCases.when: Results come from a server or need a custom ranking

useCases.use: sb-command-shortcut in the item, plus aria-keyshortcuts on the item when the app registers it
useCases.when: An action that also has a global keyboard shortcut

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.notes: sb-command: surface that stacks the search field and the list, owns the search text, the active item and the filtering, and shares them through context.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.notes: Visually hidden polite live region for the result count.

default.notes: One sb-command-input followed by one sb-command-list.

anatomy.name: input-row
anatomy.notes: Row with the bottom border, the icon and the field.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.notes: Search icon from the icon set, decorative.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native text input, the only tab stop of the command.

input.note: From the native field on every edit; read the search text from the sb-command-input value. With filter=manual this is where the consumer filters.

elements.notes: Must be a direct child of sb-command, before sb-command-list. Delegates focus, so focusing the host (or a dialog's initial focus) lands in the field.

placeholder.note: Hint shown while the field is empty ("Search documentation..."). Not an accessible name.

value.note: The search text. Setting it from code filters the list as typing does.

elements.summary: The search field: a decorative search icon and a native text input with the combobox role.

anatomy.name: list
anatomy.notes: Scrolls vertically past its maximum height; never scrolls horizontally.

default.notes: Groups of items (or items directly), separators between groups, one optional empty state.

elements.notes: Must be a child of sb-command. The active item is scrolled into view (nearest edge).
elements.summary: The scrolling list of groups, items, separators and the empty state.

elements.notes: Inside sb-command-list. Its text is what the status region announces when nothing matches.
elements.summary: Text shown only while no item matches the search text.

anatomy.name: heading
anatomy.notes: Small muted heading; absent when label is empty.

elements.notes: Inside sb-command-list. Hidden while none of its items match.

label.note: Visible heading and accessible name of the group (the section name).

elements.summary: A titled group of items (a docs section).

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.notes: Row: optional icon, text, optional shortcut at the end.

default.notes: Text, optionally a decorative leading icon and one sb-command-shortcut. No interactive content.

sb-select.note: Fires on the item when a person chooses it (Enter while active, or a click). Listen on sb-command and read event.detail.value (or event.target). Not fired for disabled items or changes made from code.

elements.notes: Inside sb-command-list or an sb-command-group. Never takes DOM focus.

disabled.note: Cannot become active or be selected; skipped by the arrows.

keywords.note: Extra space-separated words that also match (synonyms, the section name), never shown.

value.note: What the search text is matched against and what sb-select reports. Empty means the item's trimmed text. Unique within the command.

elements.summary: One option: text, optionally an icon before it and a shortcut hint after it.

elements.notes: Hidden while there is search text (filter=auto), since groups around it may be gone.

anatomy.name: shortcut
anatomy.notes: Small muted text pushed to the end of the row.

elements.notes: Inside sb-command-item. A hint only: Command does not register the shortcut.
elements.summary: A keyboard shortcut hint at the end of an item.

openQuestions.question: The list maximum height (300px in the visual reference) and the shortcut letter spacing (widest, 0.1em) have no semantic token. Add size.list.max-height and font.letter-spacing.key (plan.md, Semantic tokens to add)?
openQuestions.recommendation: Add both through the foundations flow; until then the list height is a literal with a sketchbook-allow-literal reason and the shortcut uses normal letter spacing.

openQuestions.answer: Keep the all-terms substring rule (case and accent insensitive), document order, no ranking; ranking can come later behind filter=manual.
openQuestions.question: Built-in filtering: every space-separated term of the search text must appear in value or keywords (case and accent insensitive), document order kept. Enough for the docs palette, or rank matches?
openQuestions.recommendation: Keep the substring rule and document order; ranking can come later behind filter=manual without an API change.

openQuestions.answer: Confirmed: not form-associated, an explicit exception to rule form-associated-controls (the search text is never submitted). A value-picking combobox will be its own, form-associated component. Recorded in SB-0103.
openQuestions.question: Confirm Command is not form-associated (its search text is never submitted), as an explicit exception to rule form-associated-controls.
openQuestions.recommendation: Confirm; a value-picking combobox would be a separate component that is form-associated.

openQuestions.answer: Accepted: caret only on the search field, a 2px inset ring on the active item; the a11y-auditor confirms it in the live keyboard pass.
openQuestions.question: Focus indication: no ring on the search field (caret only, as in the reference), and an added 2px inset ring on the active item so the active item does not rely on a fill below 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). Accept?
openQuestions.recommendation: Accept; the a11y-auditor confirms in the live keyboard pass.

openQuestions.answer: The manual pass is replaced by the automated screen-reader views (SB-0113): playwright/tests/command/__screen-reader__/command-arrow-down.txt and command-filtered.txt, plus the story views in playwright/tests/command/__screen-reader__/stories/.
openQuestions.question: ariaActiveDescendantElement (element reflection) is how the active item crosses the shadow boundary. Screen-reader announcement must be confirmed by hand (VoiceOver with Safari, NVDA with Chrome and Firefox).
openQuestions.recommendation: Run the manual pass before beta; if a reader stays silent, mirror the active item's name into the status region as a fallback.

openQuestions.answer: Leave all of them out of 0.1. The site owns the opening shortcut; navigation happens in the sb-select listener.
openQuestions.question: Deferred: async results with a loading state, nested pages, multi-select, registering global shortcuts (such as Cmd+K to open), item href, a controlled active value, vim-style Ctrl+N/P keys. Leave out of 0.1?
openQuestions.recommendation: Leave out; the docs palette needs none. filter=manual already allows async results; navigation happens in the sb-select listener; opening the dialog with a shortcut belongs to the app.

openQuestions.answer: Ship with the one grounded anti-pattern; add more as reviews find them.
openQuestions.question: Anti-patterns: only one is grounded in a source (interactive content in an option, APG Listbox). Any others from the owner?
openQuestions.recommendation: Ship with the one; add more as reviews find them.

filter.note: auto hides the items that do not match the search text (rule in Usage, Behavior). manual never hides items: the consumer listens to input and renders the matching items itself (remote or custom search).

label.note: Accessible name of the search field and of the list ("Search documentation"). The placeholder is not a name.

loop.note: Arrow Down on the last item moves to the first, and Arrow Up on the first moves to the last.

resultsLabel.note: Template for the polite announcement of how many items match after the search text changes; {count} is replaced by the number. Set it to translate the announcement.

disabled.note: Skipped by the arrows and by hover, not selectable, still matched and announced as unavailable.

selected.note: Active, not chosen: Enter or a click chooses it. The ring is a PROPOSAL so the active item does not rely on a fill below 3:1.
selected.trigger: the item is the active item (moved to by Arrow keys, by pointer hover, or the first match after the search text changes)

contract.summary: A search field that filters a list of grouped actions or destinations; Arrow Up and Down move the active item and Enter selects it. Used inline or inside a dialog as a command palette. Eight custom elements share state through context.

plan:
# Plan: Command (planning gate)

Status: **approved** (owner answered Q1–Q7, 2026-11-12). Test-first from here. Decisions: SB-0103, SB-0106, SB-0107 (accepted).

## Scope
In: the eight elements of the contract (`sb-command`, `-input`, `-list`, `-empty`, `-group`, `-item`, `-separator`, `-shortcut`); built-in filtering (`filter="auto"`) and `filter="manual"`; active item by arrows, hover and first match; `loop`; `sb-select`; result-count announcement (`results-label`); stories inline and inside `sb-dialog` (only if Dialog is built by then, otherwise a native `<dialog>` in the story).

Out (contract Q6): async loading state, nested pages, multi-select, global shortcut registration (Cmd+K), item `href`, a controlled active value, Ctrl+N/P keys, dialog-specific sizing, ranking.

## Files (in build order)
| Step | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `src/components/command/Command.stories.ts` (Default, Groups and shortcuts, Disabled item, Empty, Manual filter, Scrollable, In a dialog, RTL) |
| 2 | `playwright/tests/command/command.behavior.spec.ts` (written first, must fail) |
| 3 | `src/components/command/Command.scss` -> `Command.styles.ts` (generated) |
| 4 | `src/components/command/context.ts`, `Command.ts`, `CommandInput.ts`, `CommandList.ts`, `CommandEmpty.ts`, `CommandGroup.ts`, `CommandItem.ts`, `CommandSeparator.ts`, `CommandShortcut.ts`, `index.ts` |
| 5 | `npm run generate` (styles, `src/index.ts`, component tokens), then `contract.json` realizations filled |

One stylesheet for the family, as Tabs does. No new mixin or controller: `RovingFocusController` moves DOM focus, which this pattern must not do, so the arrow handling (a few lines over the visible enabled items) lives in `sb-command`. Not form-associated (Q3), so no `FormAssociated` mixin.

## Tokens
All 40 component tokens alias existing semantic tokens (contract `tokens`); no literal in the CSS. The two that were missing (Q1) are added: `size.list.max-height` (300px, base) behind `command.list.max-height`, and `font.letter-spacing.key` (`font.letter-spacing.widest`, 0.1em, from the tailwind letter-spacing preset, SB-0106/SB-0107) behind `command.shortcut.letter-spacing`.

No color token is missing (light and dark use popover, accent, muted-foreground, border, ring).

## Accessibility approach
- Search field: native `<input type="text">` in `sb-command-input`'s shadow root, `delegatesFocus`, `role="combobox"`, `aria-expanded="true"`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-label` from `sb-command`'s `label`; autocomplete/autocorrect/spellcheck off.
- Cross-root references by element reflection, never IDs (SB-0009): `input.ariaControlsElements = [list]`, `input.ariaActiveDescendantElement = activeItem` (light-DOM hosts, reached outward from the shadow root). Re-set on every filter, add or remove.
- Roles as host attributes: `listbox` (list, `aria-label` = label), `group` (named by its label; visible heading `aria-hidden`), `option` (item, `aria-selected` on the active one, `aria-disabled`). Separator and empty: `role="none"`. Hidden items: `hidden` (out of the a11y tree).
- Status: visually hidden `role="status"` in `sb-command`'s shadow root, updated after typing pauses (a short debounce in code; the delay is a `PROPOSAL` confirmed in review).
- Keyboard: ArrowDown/ArrowUp (loop optional), Enter selects and `preventDefault` (no form submit, SB-0009 point 1 in reverse), Home/End left to the field, Escape not handled.
- Forced colors: active item `Highlight`/`HighlightText`.
- The manual screen-reader pass (Q5) is replaced by the automated screen-reader views (SB-0113), stored in playwright/tests/command/__screen-reader__/*.txt.

## Test plan (test-first)
One test per contract item in `command.behavior.spec.ts`, with the helpers in `playwright/helpers/`; each must fail first (element not defined), recorded before implementing.
- Props: `label` names the combobox and the listbox; `filter=auto` hides non-matching items, groups and separators and keeps order; accent- and case-insensitive multi-term match against `value` and `keywords`; `filter=manual` hides nothing; `loop` off stops at ends, on wraps; `results-label` template used in the status text; item `value` defaults to trimmed text; `disabled` item skipped by arrows and hover, no `sb-select`.
- States: first enabled match is active after typing; hover makes active; active item has `aria-selected=true`, accent fill and ring from tokens; disabled opacity from tokens; empty state shown only with zero matches.
- Keyboard: ArrowDown/ArrowUp; Enter fires `sb-select`; Enter inside a `<form>` does not submit; Home/End move the caret; Escape propagates (a listener on an ancestor sees it); Tab leaves.
- Events: `sb-select` detail `{ value }`, bubbles, composed, target is the item, not fired from code; native `input` reaches `sb-command`.
- Accessibility: combobox/listbox/option/group roles in the accessibility snapshot; `ariaActiveDescendantElement` and `ariaControlsElements` point at the right elements after filtering; status text after typing pauses (count, then empty text); shortcut not in the option name; console warning without `label`; forced colors; axe clean on every story; inside a dialog, opening focuses the search field.
- RTL story: layout mirrors (shortcut at the inline end).

## Risks
- Element-reflection `aria-activedescendant` support and announcement differ across browser and screen-reader pairs (Q5); Playwright only proves the property, not speech.
- Keeping references and the status in sync with light-DOM changes (items added by a manual filter) needs a slot-change/mutation path; tested with the manual-filter story.
- `role` attributes on hosts nested in custom elements: axe must see option ownership through `sb-command-group`; Tabs hit a similar ownership issue (tabindex on the host).
- Dialog is being authored at the same time; the dialog story waits for it or uses a native `<dialog>`.

## Answers (owner, 2026-11-12)
- Q1 Tokens: **added** (`size.list.max-height`, `font.letter-spacing.key`).
- Q2 Filter rule: **all-terms substring, case/accent-insensitive, document order**; ranking later behind `filter=manual`.
- Q3 **Not form-associated**, an explicit exception to rule form-associated-controls (SB-0103).
- Q4 **Caret-only field, inset ring on the active item.**
- Q5 **Manual screen-reader pass** is replaced by the automated screen-reader views (SB-0113), stored in playwright/tests/command/__screen-reader__/*.txt; fallback is mirroring the active name into the status region.
- Q6 Deferred features **left out of 0.1** (list in Scope).
- Q7 **One anti-pattern** (APG Listbox).

## Documentation (check M1 and the plan's definition of done)
Before beta: `site/_examples/command.html` (curated example; the page comes from `npm run docs:components`), batch in `spec/design-docs.json`, design library (`sync library command`, verify, realize), doc page stamped `checked`, parity audit, catalog rebuilt.
